audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect line: the page never names a single Garen ability. The full layer says 'his spin' and 'Courage' with no numbers, and never once mentions the silence on Decisive Strike — which is the mechanic that decides the first five levels.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is an 8s flat cooldown that silences, and Riot's text confirms it also breaks all slows on Garen — so it beats your Q slow AND cancels your Q3 / Path Maker cast. Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s and grants shield plus tenacity before the lingering damage cut, so it shortens your Path Maker stun as well as eating the burst. Demacian Justice is missing-HP true damage, which is why All Out's stripped resists are irrelevant to surviving it.

notes: The packet's defect (page never names a Garen ability) was true of the full layer only — the content layer was already rewritten and is genuinely good, so I left it alone rather than churn it. The one unresolved item: the packet levelChart gives index 4 (Level 6) to Garen, while BOTH layers say Skill and content whys[4] argues Skill with a real mechanism (All Out out-DPSes Judgment but eats the execute). Since the two layers agree with each other, nothing renders contradictory, and the mirror audit reports it 'flipped win[4], win[5] and phases[4..5]' without saying to which side — so I did not touch it rather than risk fighting the mirror. Also worth carrying if a field opens: All Out removes Path Maker's knockback and stun, so K'Sante's W is a CC threat before R and a damage tool after.
